name: BLOODWORK OPEN: Shelf Underground Combat Circuit
description: The oldest continuously running underground combat circuit in Meridian 88's Shelf districts, BLOODWORK OPEN operates through a rotating network of decommissioned industrial spaces, flooded sub-basements, and sealed freight corridors below the Tier 1 stack. Fights are bare-knuckle or weapons-optional with minimal rules — the only consistent prohibition is firearms, enforced by the circuit's own armed marshals. Entry fees for fighters are waived; organizers profit entirely from crowd betting and the sale of fight-night recordings to gray-market neural feed distributors.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 investigative journalist goes undercover at BLOODWORK OPEN and becomes entangled with a fighter who is being coerced into throwing bouts by a gray-market augmentation creditor.

A corporate security contractor attends to recruit muscle and instead witnesses a fight that makes them question whether the violence they enable in their professional life is meaningfully different from what they're watching.

A longtime circuit organizer discovers that a new 'underground' promoter moving into their territory is actually a front for a corponation looking to absorb the circuit's betting revenue into a legalized product.
